web_dir.description: Directory to put all the gallery files (html, slides, thumbnails) into. Default is 'web'.

theme.description: Name of theme to use. Default is 'default'.

replace_spaces.description: Replaces spaces with underscores in filenames. Options: a (ask), y (yes), n (no). Default is 'y'.

index_width.description: How many thumbnails per line you want on the index page. Default is 5.

index_row.description: The number of thumbnail rows you want on the index page before a new index page is generated. 0 means no limit. Default is 0.

index_title.description: Sets the title and title-bar of the index.html page. Default is 'Photo Gallery'.

slide_y_size.description: Maximum size of slide image in the Y direction. Default is 480.

thumb_y_size.description: Size of the scaled thumbnail image in the Y direction. Default is 75.

info_y_size.description: Maximum size of the info image in the Y direction. Default is 240.

use_exif_comment.description: Use the comment field in the exif header as the slide comment. Default is DISABLED.

generate_slides.description: Generate slide pages and link them to the thumbnails. Default is ENABLED.

generate_info.description: Generate info pages and link them to the 'info' link on the slide pages. Default is ENABLED.

slide_kbsize.description: Print the file size of the slide on the index page under the thumbnails. Default is ENABLED.

slide_xysize.description: Print the slide dimensions under the thumbnails on the index page. Default is ENABLED.

use_original.description: Use the original images for the slides - do not generate a scaled slide image. Default is DISABLED.

link_original.description: Link to the original images from the slides. Default is DISABLED.

auto_rotate_originals.description: Do a lossless rotation of the original images based on EXIF Orientation. Default is DISABLED.

watermark_slides.description: Enable watermarking of the slide images. Default is DISABLED.

watermark_file.description: Name of the watermark file to use when watermarking is enabled. Default is 'watermark.png'.

watermark_gravity.description: Where to display the watermark on the slide. Options: north, south, east, west, northeast, northwest, southeast, southwest. Default is southeast.

go_back.description: Prepend a 'Go Back' link to the header in the index.html file. Default is DISABLED.

go_back_string.description: String to use for the go-back-url link. Default is 'Go Back'.

go_back_url.description: URL to use when go-back is enabled. Default is '..'.

recurse.description: Recurse through all directories on the command line. Default is DISABLED.
